summary: Applies parsed locale data. Normalizes the compare-string buffer for a1, then, if the byte at a2+64 is non-zero, calls BatchFunctionCallOverVarargs(a1, 2); if the byte at a2+128 is also non-zero, calls it again and returns that result, otherwise returns a2+128.

operations.description: sub_58FCA0(a1) normalizes the compare-string buffer identified by a1 before applying locale subtokens.
If the byte at a2+64 is non-zero, the secondary locale subtoken is present.
BatchFunctionCallOverVarargs(a1, 2) invokes the setup function with varargs for the secondary locale subtoken.
If the byte at a2+128 is non-zero, the tertiary locale subtoken is present.
BatchFunctionCallOverVarargs(a1, 2) is invoked again for the tertiary locale subtoken; its result is returned.
Otherwise returns a2+128 (pointer to the tertiary subtoken byte).
Invoked by sub_588E4E as part of the locale configuration pipeline.
